answer: Wet clay covers the tile-maker’s bench, and the wooden moulds wait oiled and ready. Proof of tile-maker via roof tile tally — a tile the tile-maker moulds only after 37 tiles lie even without one leaking at the lap, each moulded by the tile-maker himself. ridge presses the clay into the mould and trims the edge clean. knoll lifts the tile out and sets it on the drying rack. yarrow fires the tiles and sorts them by the ring of the tap. Thirty-seven tiles must lie even without one leaking at the lap, and the next still leaks where the mould ran worn.
